correctness.rationale: Direct integer graph-potential enumeration gives 1+3r(r+1) spread-ball pairs and 6r shell pairs, hence exact Ehrhart polynomial. Faulhaber derivatives and the magic transform yield exact a1/a2 Bernoulli formulas for q>=3. Euler Bernoulli-zeta formula establishes |B_r|>=r/12 for even r>=14 and |B_{q+1}|>3 B_{q-1} for q>=15, q=3 mod4; these force negative magic coefficients for all q>=13. Exact full vectors prove positivity q<=6 and six explicit rational witnesses cover q=7..12. A self-contained standard-library verifier independently checks 410 rational/integer identities; finite computations do not substitute for infinite analytic reasoning.

value.rationale: The natural complete-bipartite family K3q is already the subject of a finite sign table. Its sharp infinite classification requires ruling out positivity return in every remaining dimension, rather than computing an arbitrary finite example. The new exact shell count differs structurally from the previous K2q formula; both the first and second magic coefficients and residue-dependent Bernoulli bounds are needed. This gives a complete theorem with motivated boundary and plausible role in further K_{p,q} classification; the latter is not claimed.
